title: Fix 6 EditMode tests that fail under the Unity Test Runner (CWD-relative path walks + GC allocation sensor) though green headless
description:
Found 2026-07-08 when the human ran the FULL Unity EditMode suite via the Test Runner UI: 663/669 passed, 6 failed. All 6 are Unity-Test-Runner ENVIRONMENT issues, NOT product-logic bugs (the same tests are green in the headless fast suite, 668/668). They surface because the headless gate runs with CWD = repo root while the Unity Editor runs tests with CWD = the Unity install dir (C:\\Program Files\\Unity\\Hub\\Editor\\6000.0.38f1\\Editor). This is the same 'green-headless / red-Unity' divergence family as TASK-074 (NUnit version) but via different mechanisms (filesystem CWD assumption + GC sensor behavior).

THE 6 FAILURES:
(1-3) MicrogameContentGeneratorSpecsTests.{EverySpec_DurationIsWithinGdd11_1Bound, EverySpec_MigratesToAValidV2Definition, ExactlyThreeSpecsExist} — System.IO.FileNotFoundException 'Could not locate Barcade/Assets/Barcade/Editor/MicrogameContentGenerator.cs by walking up from <Unity install dir>'. Root: FindGeneratorSource() at MicrogameContentGeneratorSpecsTests.cs:57 walks up from Directory.GetCurrentDirectory().
(4-5) MicrogameDefinitionMigratorTests.{EveryDefinition_MigratesToAValidV2Definition_WithNoFieldLoss, ExactlyTwelveDefinitionAssetsExist} — System.IO.DirectoryNotFoundException 'Could not locate Barcade/Assets/Barcade/Content/Microgames by walking up from <Unity install dir>'. Root: FindMicrogamesFolder() at MicrogameDefinitionMigratorTests.cs:47, same CWD walk-up pattern.
(6) BoardModelTests.AllocationSensor_CanActuallyDetectAnAllocation (BoardModelTests.cs:334) — 'GC.GetAllocatedBytesForCurrentThread must observe a deliberate allocation; Expected greater than 0; But was 0'. Under Unity's editor runtime the sensor read a 0-byte delta for a deliberate allocation. SUBTLE VALIDITY CONCERN: if that sensor always reads 0 under Unity, then the SteadyStateTick_AllocatesNoManagedMemory-style no-alloc assertions (which DID pass under Unity) may be passing VACUOUSLY under the Unity runner while remaining meaningful headless. Investigate whether the no-alloc guarantees are actually being exercised under Unity.

FIX DIRECTION (evaluate in planning): for (1-5), anchor path resolution on a Unity-aware root instead of Directory.GetCurrentDirectory() — e.g. try UnityEngine.Application.dataPath (== <project>/Assets in the Editor) first, fall back to the CWD walk-up for the headless dotnet run so BOTH environments resolve. For (6), determine why GC.GetAllocatedBytesForCurrentThread returns 0 under Unity's Mono editor runtime and either make the sensor Unity-robust or platform-guard the sanity assertion, ensuring the no-alloc tests are not vacuous under Unity.

GOAL: Unity Test Runner EditMode suite reaches 669/669 (or the sanity-guard is correctly platform-scoped), headless fast suite stays 668/668, and the no-alloc assertions remain non-vacuous in both environments.
acceptance_criteria: The Unity EditMode Test Runner run shows 0 failures for MicrogameContentGeneratorSpecsTests (3 tests) and MicrogameDefinitionMigratorTests (2 tests) — path resolution works whether CWD is the repo root (headless) or the Unity install dir (Editor)

BoardModelTests.AllocationSensor_CanActuallyDetectAnAllocation either passes under Unity or is correctly platform-scoped, AND it is verified that the no-alloc assertions (e.g. SteadyStateTick_AllocatesNoManagedMemory) are NOT vacuous under the Unity runner
The headless fast suite remains green (668/668) after the changes
No new CWD-relative Directory.GetCurrentDirectory() walk-ups are introduced; the chosen anchor strategy is documented so future EditMode tests follow it
